fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. Property fronts a public street (N O Street) that ends in a cul-de-sac turnaround; the building's parking and the east-side tank/work yard are reached directly from the street with no barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth anywhere on the property. Modern office facade on the west end, but no guard structure.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short access straight off the N O Street cul-de-sac to the parking lot and yard; minimal queuing depth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Winery production building. No bank of dedicated freight dock doors visible. Personnel doors and ~2-4 at-grade service/roll-up doors estimated along the working (east) face by the tank farm. Low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No marked trailer-parking stalls with parked trailers. The east-side row is outdoor wine storage tanks, not a trailer drop.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Lompoc is a small city (~42K). The facility sits in the Lompoc industrial/'Wine Ghetto' district on the edge of town next to the airport and farmland. Per rubric, small-town industrial resolves to Rural.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single long winery production building (the maroon-roof structure at 1604 N O Street). The adjacent large white building to the east is a separate, unrelated tenant.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.publicAccess: Sea Smoke is not open for public tastings; wines are pre-allocated. Operation is winery production and allocated shipping only.
